decisive_spans.text: Serum parvovirus B19 (PVB19) IgM and IgG antibodies were detectable
PVB19 DNA was found (viral load of 0.2 PVB19 DNA copies/β-globin gene copy, or 33,438 copies/µg of isolated DNA) in lesional skin biopsy specimen

response.rationale: D4 is strongly supported by the presence of PVB19 IgM and IgG antibodies and PVB19 DNA in the lesional skin biopsy. D2 is a possible diagnosis given the sun exposure and pruritic eruption, but lacks specific supporting evidence compared to D4.
